name: Proxmox
description: A Proxmox estate in Orca, through Proxmox Datacenter Manager or PVE and PBS directly (optionally over SSH): hosts and guests with live charts and disk use, tasks, backups and where Orca runs; alerts and a status-bar summary; read-only.

cover.alt: Proxmox for Orca: the panel with host cards in the light theme and the estate tree in the dark theme, from an example estate

screenshots.alt: Host cards with CPU, memory and network charts; the estate tree in the dark theme; the guests table with disk use and one guest opened
screenshots.caption: Hosts, the estate tree and guests

screenshots.alt: Tasks of every remote with two failed backups; where a new VM fits, best node first; Orca hosts placed on their Proxmox nodes
screenshots.caption: Tasks, the placement planner and where Orca runs

screenshots.alt: The Copy for AI preview without addresses; backups by age; the settings with a PDM, a PVE and a PBS connection, each read-only and pinned
screenshots.caption: Copy for AI, backups and the connections

settings.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open panel reloads the estate.

settings.title: Backup age warning (hours)
settings.description: A guest whose newest PBS snapshot is older than this is flagged.

settings.title: Backup scan interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often PBS snapshot lists are read; they are the slowest part of a refresh.

settings.title: Show where Orca runs
settings.description: Mark the hosts and guests that run Orca, with their bots and workspaces. Read with the orca CLI that comes with Orca, since the plugin API does not list hosts or bots yet; also reads node networks and guest configs for addresses.

settings.title: Disk use inside VMs
settings.description: Read each running VM's filesystem use from its QEMU guest agent (get-fsinfo; on PVE 9 the PVEAuditor role allows it). Off: the plugin never asks the agent, and VMs show their allocated size.

settings.title: Status bar item
settings.description: Show remotes up and the main issue (stale backups, failed tasks, filling disks) in the status bar; pressing it opens the panel.

settings.title: Alert: remote unreachable
settings.description: Notify when a remote stays unreachable for two refreshes.

settings.title: Alert: guest stopped
settings.description: Notify when a guest that was running is no longer running (two refreshes in a row).

settings.title: Alert: backup failed
settings.description: Notify when a backup task (vzdump or PBS backup) fails.

settings.title: Alert: backup stale
settings.description: Notify when a guest's newest backup becomes older than the backup age warning.
